description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with various language families and individual languages, as part of a study on morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models. The horizontal axis represents the number of tasks, labeled as "# tasks," with a scale ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. The vertical axis lists language categories, including IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkish, and Basque. Each category is represented by a colored horizontal bar, with the length of the bar corresponding to the number of tasks. The IE-Slavic category has the longest bar, indicating the highest number of tasks, approximately 78. The IE-Romance category follows with about 47 tasks, and the IE-Germanic category has around 44 tasks. The remaining categories show a decreasing trend, with IE-Baltic at approximately 17 tasks, IE-other at about 15, IE-Indic at around 10, Semitic at roughly 8, Turkish at about 5, and Basque at approximately 4 tasks. The bars are sorted in descending order of the number of tasks, and the chart uses distinct colors for each category to differentiate them visually.
